decision: Initial paired kernel showed no throughput gain. Preserve it and inspect/revise register lifetimes and activation-load reuse before another candidate.
compiler_observation: Assembly stores floating accumulators and scale vectors on the stack; activation reads are folded into separate XOR operations. Source-level sharing did not reliably produce shared activation registers.
limitations: CPU placement differs, with more caller overlap on worker physical cores in the enabled run.
Outputs and acceptance differ, so the end-to-end percentage is not an isolated kernel speed measurement.
Neither run meets the 900/30 target; 128k remains unverified.
